description: CodeScope-local specification for selecting and supplying Eliware Convention v8 records to reviews.

authoritativeFor: CodeScope convention-evidence selection and review-input boundaries.
notAuthoritativeFor: Repository requirements, convention wording, exemptions, operational procedures, publication, deployment, or project behavior.

crosslinks.authoritativeFor: Universal repository conventions and profile authority.

conventionEvidence.applicability: Read only the Convention directive records named by package.json eliware.apply. For the @eliware/test package, supply every canonical Convention directive record so its validator can verify complete coverage. Directive examples are inline explanatory evidence and do not create a separate contract record.
conventionEvidence.authority: Treat the linked Conventions records as the sole authority for repository requirements and directive text.
conventionEvidence.missingEvidence: If the canonical Conventions checkout or an applied directive record is unavailable, report convention alignment as unverified. Do not infer or import requirements.
conventionEvidence.scope: Supply the selected canonical records as review evidence. Do not redefine, duplicate, or extend their requirements.
